ns2:course.label: Organization of Higher Education
ns2:course.description: Examination of American higher education both as a system and as a field of study. Includes consideration of organizational patterns, stakeholders, governance, and the purposes of higher education. Same as EOL 570. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EOL 570. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Priority will be given to department majors.
